verified_results.statement: For a dimensionless angular coordinate chi with period Delta_chi, the coordinate components have dimensions A_chi=M, F_rchi=M^2 and Q=M^3 while the orthonormal magnetic field F_rchi/L has dimension M^3.
The periodic localized phase obeys sigma(chi+Delta_chi)-sigma(chi)=2 pi N_sigma and enters through the gauge-invariant combination d_chi=2 pi N_sigma/Delta_chi-q_sigma A_chi.
The structural global U(1) condition is q_ref Phi_F=2 pi N_F; q_ref cannot be identified with q_sigma unless the localized phase is proven to carry the minimal reference charge.

The MD-2S dependency pipeline has been encoded as an acyclic P0-to-P6 graph with explicit R1.1 blockers, but graph execution remains blocked by unresolved model, charge, frame, topology and numerical-contract nodes.

With outward normals on both regions, the two independent metric junction equations require Y_sigma=(L_Sigma-A_Sigma)/kappa6_squared and lambda=(7 A_Sigma+L_Sigma)/(2 kappa6_squared).
